title: Appropriation Fidelity & Funding Engine
description: Normalizes funding documents, evaluates appropriation fidelity, supports funding-alignment review, and provides post-deployment stability inputs for the A.B.E. pipeline.

plain_language.main_question: Did the funding stay connected to the purpose it was allocated for?
secondary_questions: What authority or appropriation was connected to the funding?
Did the funding appear aligned with program scope?
Did deployment remain stable after recovery capital was modeled?
plain_language.user_summary: AFFE helps users turn funding documents into structured artifacts and understand whether funding, appropriation purpose, and deployment remain aligned.

role_in_pipeline.primary_role: Funding normalization and appropriation fidelity layer
role_in_pipeline.position: Runs after CCRI in the full pipeline, while also supporting CFF when funding documents are used as source inputs.

license.citation: Shouse, T. American Butterfly Effect (ABE). Zenodo.
